messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 5xx spike detected across gateway service. 2.3x baseline errors in last 3m, p50 latency up 40%. Potential source: high KV miss rate on prefix-cache cluster prod-west-1. Paging oncall-sean :rotating_light:
oncall-sean: I'm on it, waking up my setup. pinging @sre_ana for cache hints.
sre_ana: grabbing initial graphs. I see eviction_rate jump ~x8 at 2024-05-16T02:07Z for prefix-shard-12. KV miss ratio correlates with 502 spikes.
eng_miguel: any deploys in the last hour?
oncall-sean: no prod deploys. Last config change was prefetch rollout at 01:30 for prefix cache (canary).
sre_ana: that matches—prefetch seems to be aggressively populating and thrashing LRU, causing eviction storms. Some pods reporting cache checksum mismatch errors.
infra_bot: CPU on prefix-cache nodes jumped to 92% on shard-12, memory churn high. Autoscaler didn't spin new nodes due to scale-protection window.
sre_ana: mitigations: 1) disable prefetch on canaries 2) throttle eviction frequency 3) route traffic to fallback cached model (cold path) while we stabilize.
oncall-sean: executing disable now. Command: ```kubectl -n cache rollout restart deploy/prefetch-worker --selector=canary=true```
eng_miguel: don't restart everything. We should flip the feature flag first. Feature API: ```POST /feature-flags/prefetch/canary -d '{"enabled": false}'```
oncall-sean: good point. Running flag toggle.```
sre_ana: flag toggle acknowledged. Observability: eviction_rate dropped in 30s on two canaries, but overall cluster still has high miss rate. Need broader mitigation.
product_lee: customer-impact? Any visible errors reported in support queue?
support_jay: two customers reported UI timeouts; no HA breaks yet. Working on outbound comms to affected tenants.
eng_miguel: propose immediate routing rule: for prod-west-1 route 20% of traffic to dedicated fallback cluster (verifier) and set 503->retry policy at gateway. Config snippet: ```route-rule: - match: region==west-1  weight:80 to:cacheshared weight:20 fallback:verifier```
sre_ana: applying route change now. Also increasing cache heal concurrency to reduce cache-repopulate thundering herd: ```kvctl set-param --shard 12 --repopulate-delay 200ms```
oncall-sean: route change applied. Gateway 5xx rate down to 1.3x baseline. P50 latency trending down.
infra_bot: new autoscale request queued; nodes provisioning, ETA ~90s. If eviction storm continues, we may need to temporarily raise eviction TTL to avoid churn.
sre_ana: prepared command to bump TTL: ```kvctl set-ttl --shard 12 --ttl 60s``` but prefer avoid if not needed.
eng_miguel: I'm going to open a rollback for the prefetch canary rollout and set canary to paused. If we still see corruption checksums, we'll run a consistency scan: ```kv-scan --shard 12 --verify-checksums```
support_jay: sending status update to reported customers: short note about degraded performance, teams are mitigating, ETA 30m.
product_lee: good. Keep us posted on SLO impact numbers, we'll prepare comms if it crosses thresholds.
sre_ana: consistency scan queued; initial results show ~0.05% checksum mismatches on shard-12, likely due to concurrent writes during prefetch eviction. Not widespread.
oncall-sean: doing handoff to oncall+eng@30m. If anything worsens, page me again.
eng_miguel: after rollback and throttle, recommend postmortem to cover prefetch heuristics, autoscaler protection window, and eviction backpressure controls.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident severity auto-updated to P2 due to partial customer impact. Please update pagerduty incident with mitigations taken.
sre_ana: follow-ups: (1) tweak prefetch policy to respect shard free_mem threshold, (2) add eviction-throttle circuit breaker in runtime, (3) add better dashboard for checksum mismatches.
oncall-sean: thanks team. Handoff: @sre_ana and @eng_miguel will monitor for next 30m, I'll be reachable if it spikes.
support_jay: sent final customer note. No new reports in last 10m.
product_lee: closing loop: prepare a short RCA draft once stable. Good mitigation work. :thumbsup:
